comments: Searches identity providers with the specified criteria and pagination.

params.name: applicationId
comments: (Optional) The application Id to search for identity providers.

params.name: name
comments: (Optional) The name of the identity provider to search for. Supports wildcard search using *.

params.name: numberOfResults
comments: (Optional) The number of results to return. Defaults to 25.

params.name: orderBy
comments: (Optional) The field to order the results by. Supported values: enabled, id, insertInstant, name, type.

params.name: startRow
comments: (Optional) The offset into the total results. Defaults to 0.

params.name: tenantId
comments: (Optional) The tenant Id to restrict the results to.

params.name: type
comments: (Optional) The type of identity provider to search for.
